## Description {#details}

<p>Combination generator.</p>


<p>Example: given input {{0, 1}, {2}, {3, 4}} it will produce the following combinations: {0, 2, 3}, {0, 2, 4}, {1, 2, 3}, {1, 2, 4}.</p>


<p>It is useful to think of input as vector-of-vectors, where the outer vector is the variable space, and inner vector is choice space. The number of choices for each variable can be different.</p>


<p>As for implementation, it is useful to think of this as a weird number, where each digit (==variable) may have different base (==number of choices). Thus modelling of 'produce next combination' is exactly analogous to the incrementing of an number - increment lowest digit (pick next choice for the variable), and if it wrapped to the beginning then increment next digit.</p>
